# Amazon Self Publishers

> Amazon Self Publishers (amazonselfpublishers.co) is an independent publishing-services company. It offers book publishing, Amazon KDP publishing support, editing, cover design, formatting, ghostwriting, marketing and related services to authors. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Amazon; authors can publish on Amazon KDP directly and free of charge, and Amazon Self Publishers charges only for the optional services an author chooses.

This file contains the main text of https://amazonselfpublishers.co/ for language models. Page URLs are given so answers can link to the source.

## Important disclosure
amazonselfpublishers is an independent publishing-services provider. We are not owned by, endorsed by, or officially affiliated with Amazon, Kindle Direct Publishing, or any of their subsidiaries. Amazon and Kindle are trademarks of their respective owners. Authors can publish on Amazon KDP directly and free of charge; we charge only for the optional services they choose.

## How it works
- Tell us about your book: Share your manuscript status, goals and timeline through the form or by phone.
- Get a clear plan: We outline the services your book needs, in order, with scope and next steps.
- Build and review: Writing, editing, design and formatting move forward in stages, and you approve each one.
- Publish with confidence: We prepare final files and your listing, and guide you through release.
- Promote and grow: Optional marketing and promotion support to help readers discover your book.

## Frequently asked questions
### Can I publish on Amazon myself?
Yes. Amazon KDP is free to use and you can publish there directly at kdp.amazon.com. We are an independent company, not affiliated with Amazon, and we charge only for the editing, design, formatting and publishing support you choose.

### Are you affiliated with Amazon?
No. amazonselfpublishers is an independent publishing-services company. We are not owned by, endorsed by or officially partnered with Amazon or Kindle Direct Publishing.

### Do I keep the rights to my book?
Yes. Authors retain ownership of their work, and any agreement we make should say so clearly.

### Can I choose individual services instead of a full package?
Yes. You can hire us for editing only, a cover only, formatting only, or any combination your book needs.

### How long does it take to publish a book?
Timelines depend on manuscript length, editing needs and how quickly feedback is returned. We will give you a realistic estimate after reading your project.

### Do you guarantee sales or bestseller status?
No. No honest publisher can. We focus on producing a professional book and giving it a well-prepared launch.

### What do I need to get started?
A manuscript or an idea, plus a short description of what you want to achieve. Fill in the inquiry form or call us and we will take it from there.

URL: https://amazonselfpublishers.co/publishing-services

**Take Your Manuscript from Draft to Finished Book**

From editing and book design to formatting and publishing support, we help you prepare your manuscript for readers while keeping control of your creative work.

A book involves several stages, from reviewing the manuscript to preparing the final files for publication. Our services provide support with the parts of the process you choose.

Whether you need help with editing, cover design, formatting or publishing preparation, we can discuss your requirements and identify the services that suit your project.

Who it is for:
- Free initial discussion about your project
- Optional services based on your requirements
- Clear explanation of the agreed scope
- Support with preparing your book for publication

What is included:
- Manuscript Review: Review the manuscript requirements and identify the type of editing or preparation support needed.
- Editing Coordination: Discuss editing and proofreading requirements based on the manuscript's condition and project scope.
- Cover and Interior Design: Prepare cover and interior design files according to the book's format and agreed specifications.
- Format Preparation: Prepare the manuscript layout and publishing files for the selected book format.
- File Setup and Support: Help prepare the required files and explain the next steps in the publishing process.
- Launch Preparation: Review the agreed deliverables and help you prepare for your chosen publishing route.

Process:
- Share Your Manuscript Details: Tell us about your book, its current stage and your goals.
- Discuss Your Options: Review the services, deliverables and project requirements.
- Review the Work: Review the agreed deliverables and provide feedback where applicable.
- Prepare for Publication: Prepare the final files and next steps according to the agreed scope.

Benefits:
- Choose only the services you need.
- Understand the scope of your project before proceeding.
- Get support with editing, design and formatting.
- Keep control of your creative work.
- Discuss your publishing options with an independent service provider.

Questions:

Q: Can I select only some of your services?
A: Yes. You can choose the services that suit your project. We can discuss your requirements and explain the available options before you decide.

Q: How long does book publishing take?

Q: Do you offer manuscript editing?
A: Editing and proofreading support can be discussed according to your manuscript's condition and requirements.

Q: How do I get started?
A: Complete the quote form with your contact details and information about your book. Our team can then discuss your requirements and the next steps.

Q: Do I keep the rights to my book?

Q: Do you promise bestseller status?

## Amazon Publishing Support
URL: https://amazonselfpublishers.co/amazon-publishing-services

**Get help publishing your book on Amazon KDP**

From formatting and cover files to categories, keywords and a polished book page, we help you prepare a complete, platform-ready release. Independent service, not affiliated with Amazon.

Amazon offers independent authors a direct route to readers, but the set-up has many moving parts: trim sizes, bleed, file types, metadata, categories, pricing and rights choices. Mistakes at this stage can delay your release or make the finished book look unprofessional.

We prepare the files, guide you through the account and listing decisions, and make sure what you upload matches the platform requirements.

Who it is for:
- Authors ready to upload a finished manuscript
- Writers unsure about formats, trim sizes or categories
- Authors whose files were rejected or look wrong in preview
- Anyone planning ebook and paperback editions together

What is included:
- Account and rights guidance: Plain explanations of the choices you make on the platform, so your own account stays under your control.
- Ebook and print file preparation: Interior and cover files built to the specification for each edition you choose.
- Title and subtitle review: A check that your title data is consistent across cover, listing and files.
- Categories and keywords: Research-led suggestions for categories and search phrases that match what your book is about.
- Book description: A readable, honest book description written to help the right reader decide to buy.
- Pre-publication checklist: A final walkthrough of previews, proofs, pricing and release timing.

Process:
- Tell us about your book: Share genre, formats, manuscript status and publication goals.
- Prepare files: We format the interior and cover files to current platform requirements.
- Build the listing: We shape your title data, description, categories and keywords.
- Review and publish: You preview everything and press publish from your own account.

Benefits:
- You publish from your own account and control your book
- Files prepared to avoid common rejection issues
- A listing built around how readers actually search
- Support for ebook and paperback together

Questions:
Q: Can I publish on Amazon myself?
A: Yes. Amazon KDP is free to use and you can publish there directly at kdp.amazon.com. We are an independent company, not affiliated with Amazon, and we charge only for the editing, design, formatting and publishing support you choose.

Q: Are you affiliated with Amazon?
A: No. We are an independent publishing-services company. We are not owned by, endorsed by or officially partnered with Amazon.

Q: Will I publish from my own account?
A: Yes. We guide you through the process so the account, royalties and book remain yours.

Q: Can you help if my files were rejected?
A: Usually, yes. Send us the notice you received and the files, and we will tell you what needs to change.

Q: Do you guarantee sales or rankings?
A: No. Sales depend on many factors, including the book, genre, pricing and promotion. We make sure your release is professional and complete.

Q: Can I publish both ebook and paperback?
A: Yes. We can prepare both editions so the covers, text and listing stay consistent.

## Book Marketing
URL: https://amazonselfpublishers.co/book-marketing-services

**A marketing plan built around your book and your readers**

Good marketing starts with knowing who your reader is and where they already look for books. We help you build a plan you can sustain, with clear steps for launch and beyond.

Many books are published well and still go unnoticed because nothing was done to put them in front of readers. Marketing is not a single burst of advertising. It is a set of repeatable habits tied to your genre, budget and goals.

We create a marketing roadmap, set up the pieces that support it, and help you carry it out, or carry out parts of it for you.

Who it is for:
- Authors preparing for a first release
- Authors whose book has stalled after launch
- Non-fiction writers building authority
- Authors with a series to promote

What is included:
- Reader and market profile: A written picture of your likely readers, comparable titles and the places those readers spend time.
- Positioning and messaging: A concise hook, tagline and key messages you can reuse everywhere.
- Launch calendar: A week-by-week plan covering pre-launch, launch week and the weeks that follow.
- Content for channels: Posts, newsletter copy and short promotional pieces adapted to the channels you choose.
- Review and outreach plan: A respectful approach to requesting reader reviews and contacting bloggers or newsletter owners.
- Progress review: A check-in on what is working so effort goes where it pays off.

Process:
- Discovery: We review your book, audience, budget and timeline.
- Strategy: We recommend a focused set of channels and tactics.
- Build: We prepare the assets your campaign needs.
- Run and review: We carry out the plan with you and adjust based on results.

Benefits:
- A plan matched to your genre and budget
- Honest expectations, with no promised rankings
- Reusable messaging for years of promotion
- Clear priorities so you do not spread yourself thin

Questions:
Q: Can you guarantee a bestseller?
A: No. Anyone offering that guarantee should be questioned. We can improve your visibility and preparation, but results depend on many factors.

Q: Do I need a big budget?
A: Not necessarily. Some of the most effective early steps cost little. We recommend what fits your budget.

Q: When should marketing start?
A: Ideally before publication, so you have a platform and early readers at launch. It still helps after release.

Q: Do you run paid advertising?
A: We can advise on and help set up paid campaigns. Any ad spend is paid by you directly to the advertising platform.

## Ebook Writing
URL: https://amazonselfpublishers.co/ebook-writing-services

**Ebooks written clearly, structured carefully, ready to read**

Whether you are building authority, growing an email list or publishing a Kindle title, our writers turn your ideas and expertise into an ebook that is organised, readable and original.

An ebook rewards tight structure. Readers scan on a phone or e-reader, so chapters need strong openings, short paragraphs and a clear promise delivered on time.

We work from your outline, notes or a short interview, research where needed, and write in the voice that suits your audience.

Who it is for:
- Consultants and coaches creating a flagship guide
- Businesses producing lead-magnet ebooks
- Authors writing non-fiction for Kindle
- Experts who know the subject but lack writing time

What is included:
- Topic and outline: A chapter structure agreed with you before drafting begins.
- Original writing: A full draft written for your audience, free of recycled filler.
- Research and fact checks: Claims checked against reliable sources where research is part of the brief.
- Revision round: Reasonable changes to tone, structure and emphasis after your review.
- Reader-friendly formatting: Headings, lists and chapter summaries suited to on-screen reading.
- Final manuscript: A clean document ready for design or direct upload preparation.

Process:
- Brief: Share topic, audience, length and voice.
- Outline: We propose and refine a chapter plan.
- Draft: Chapters are written and delivered for review.
- Revise: We apply your feedback and finalise the manuscript.

Benefits:
- Expert ideas turned into polished prose
- Clear structure that holds attention
- A consistent voice from first page to last
- Time saved for you to run your business or write your own book

Questions:
Q: Will the ebook be original?
A: Yes. Content is written for your project and not resold or reused.

Q: Do I own the finished ebook?
A: Ownership terms are set out in your agreement. Our standard approach is that the finished work belongs to you.

Q: How long can the ebook be?
A: Any length from short lead magnets to full-length guides. We scope by word count and complexity.

Q: Can you match my voice?
A: Yes. Samples of your writing or a short interview help us capture your tone.

## Ebook Publishing
URL: https://amazonselfpublishers.co/ebook-publishing-services

**Publish an ebook that reads beautifully on every device**

We convert your manuscript into clean, reflowable ebook files, prepare the cover and metadata, and guide you through uploading to the stores where your readers shop.

Ebooks are not simply print pages saved as a file. They reflow to fit a screen, honour the reader's font choices and rely on a working table of contents. Poor conversion shows up as odd spacing, broken links and missing chapters.

We build ebooks the way e-readers expect them, then test them on multiple viewing environments before you publish.

Who it is for:
- Authors with a finished manuscript
- Publishers moving a backlist to digital
- Businesses releasing ebook guides
- Authors choosing between exclusive and wide distribution

What is included:
- Reflowable EPUB build: Clean code, working navigation and consistent styling.
- Kindle-compatible file: A file prepared for upload to Kindle Direct Publishing.
- Ebook cover specifications: Cover dimensions and file settings that meet store requirements.
- Metadata preparation: Title, series, contributors, description and keywords organised for each store.
- Device checks: Review in preview tools and on common devices to catch layout problems.
- Distribution guidance: An explanation of store options, exclusivity trade-offs and pricing considerations.

Process:
- Submit your manuscript: Send the final text and cover.
- Convert: We produce the ebook files.
- Test: We check on multiple viewers and fix issues.
- Upload and release: We guide you through publishing from your own accounts.

Benefits:
- Files that behave properly on e-readers and apps
- Fewer upload rejections
- Metadata that helps readers find your book
- Freedom to choose your own distribution route

Questions:
Q: Which file formats do you provide?
A: We provide EPUB and a Kindle-compatible file, depending on where you plan to publish.

Q: Should I go exclusive with one store?
A: It depends on your goals. We explain the trade-offs so you can choose.

Q: Can you convert from Word or Google Docs?
A: Yes. Clean Word documents give the best results, and we can tidy files that need work.

Q: Do you handle fixed-layout ebooks?
A: Fixed layout is used for picture books and some illustrated titles. Tell us about your project and we will confirm what is feasible.

## Audiobook
URL: https://amazonselfpublishers.co/audio-book-services

**Give your book a voice with professional audiobook production**

Audiobook listeners are a growing audience. We help you choose a narrator, record, edit and master your book to the standards that audiobook retailers expect.

A good audiobook depends on three things: a narrator whose voice fits the story, a clean recording and careful post-production. Skipping any one of these is noticeable within the first minute.

We manage the whole sequence, from casting auditions to finished files, so you can focus on feedback instead of audio engineering.

Who it is for:
- Fiction authors with strong dialogue
- Memoirists who want a personal feel
- Non-fiction authors reaching commuters and learners
- Authors who want to narrate their own book

What is included:
- Narrator search: Audition samples from voices matched to your genre and tone.
- Script preparation: Pronunciation notes and chapter breakdown for the narrator.
- Recording and direction: Studio-quality recording with corrections for misreads.
- Editing and mastering: Noise reduction, levelling and consistent loudness.
- Quality control: A full listen for clicks, breaths and pacing issues.
- Retail-ready files: Files and cover art sized to audiobook retailer requirements.

Process:
- Discuss your book: Genre, length, tone and narration preferences.
- Cast: Review auditions and choose a voice.
- Record and edit: Chapters are recorded, edited and sent for review.
- Master and deliver: Final files are prepared for upload.

Benefits:
- A narrator matched to your story
- Technical specs handled for you
- Review and correction rounds
- A new format for a different audience

Questions:
Q: Can I narrate my own book?
A: Yes. We can direct and edit your recordings, or advise on recording at home.

Q: How is audiobook cost calculated?
A: Typically by finished length, narrator and level of editing. We provide a quote after reviewing your manuscript.

Q: Do I need a special cover?
A: Audiobooks use a square cover. We can adapt your existing design.

Q: Where can I sell my audiobook?
A: Several retailers accept independent audiobooks. We outline the options and their terms.

## SEO Optimized Content
URL: https://amazonselfpublishers.co/seo-optimized-content-services

**Content that readers enjoy and search engines can understand**

We research what your audience searches for, plan topics around it and write original pages and articles that serve readers first. Rankings can't be promised, but sound content gives you a fair chance.

Search optimisation is not stuffing keywords into paragraphs. It is understanding what a person is trying to learn or buy, and giving them the best answer on the page.

Our SEO content service combines keyword research with experienced writing, so your site gains pages that are useful, readable and properly structured.

Who it is for:
- Authors building a website
- Small publishers growing organic traffic
- Service businesses in the book industry
- Teams that need steady content without hiring in-house

What is included:
- Keyword and topic research: A list of phrases and questions your audience actually uses.
- Content plan: Priority pages and articles with suggested titles and outlines.
- Original articles and pages: Researched, edited copy written to your brief.
- On-page optimisation: Titles, meta descriptions, headings and internal link suggestions.
- Readability pass: Plain language, scannable structure and clear calls to action.
- Performance notes: Guidance on what to measure and when to update content.

Process:
- Audit: Review existing content and goals.
- Research: Find topics worth ranking for.
- Write: Produce and edit content.
- Refine: Update based on results and feedback.

Benefits:
- Content designed for people first
- No keyword stuffing or recycled text
- A practical publishing schedule
- Honest expectations about timing

Questions:
Q: Can you guarantee first-page rankings?
A: No one can. Search results depend on many factors outside our control. We follow sound practice and measure progress.

Q: How long does SEO take?
A: Usually months, not days. New content takes time to be indexed and to earn visibility.

Q: Do you use AI-generated filler?
A: We write original, human-edited content. We do not publish thin, mass-produced text.

Q: Can you update old pages?
A: Yes. Refreshing existing content is often the quickest improvement.

## Book Formatting
URL: https://amazonselfpublishers.co/book-formatting

**Interior pages designed so the book is a pleasure to read**

Print and ebook formatting are different crafts. We set your text with proper margins, typography and structure for each edition and test the files before you publish.

Formatting is the quiet part of book design. When it is done well, nobody notices. When it is done badly, readers see cramped margins, awkward line breaks and inconsistent headings.

We build print interiors with the correct trim size, margins and page numbering, and separately build reflowable ebooks that adapt to any screen.

Who it is for:
- Authors with a Word or Google Docs manuscript
- Authors whose uploads showed errors
- Writers needing ebook and paperback files
- Authors of illustrated or non-fiction titles

What is included:
- Print interior (PDF): Correct trim size, bleed settings, mirrored margins and running heads.
- Ebook files (EPUB): Reflowable layout with working table of contents.
- Typography selection: A typeface and styling that suits your genre.
- Chapter openings: Consistent headings, drop caps or ornaments if desired.
- Front and back matter: Title page, copyright page, dedication, about the author.
- Preview proof: A proof to review before final files are issued.

Process:
- Intake: We review your manuscript and choose specifications.
- Layout: We build the interior.
- Proof: You review and mark changes.
- Finalise: We deliver upload-ready files.

Benefits:
- Print and ebook handled by one team
- Specs matched to your printer or platform
- Consistent, readable typography
- Fewer rejections at upload

Questions:
Q: What is the difference between print and ebook formatting?
A: Print is fixed: every page is laid out. Ebooks reflow to the reader's device, so they are built differently.

Q: Which trim size should I choose?
A: It depends on genre and length. We recommend sizes commonly used for your type of book.

Q: Can you format images and tables?
A: Yes, with attention to resolution and placement. Complex layouts may affect the quote.

Q: Do I need to edit before formatting?
A: Yes, ideally. Text changes after layout can create extra work.

## Book Video Trailer
URL: https://amazonselfpublishers.co/book-trailer

**A short film that makes readers want the first page**

A book trailer tells your story in under a minute. We script, design and edit trailers that suit your genre and are cut for the places readers actually watch.

Video is a quick way to show a book's mood. A thriller trailer should feel tense; a memoir trailer should feel personal. The aim is to create curiosity, not to summarise the plot.

We use licensed footage, motion graphics, text and music so you avoid copyright issues, and we deliver versions for each platform.

Who it is for:
- Fiction authors with strong atmosphere
- Non-fiction authors promoting a message
- Authors launching a series
- Anyone needing video for social media

What is included:
- Concept and script: A short script built around your hook.
- Visual direction: Style, colour and typography matched to your cover.
- Licensed assets: Stock footage and music with appropriate licences.
- Editing and motion graphics: Smooth cuts, titles and transitions.
- Multiple aspect ratios: Versions for widescreen, square and vertical video.
- Revision round: Adjustments after your review.

Process:
- Brief: Share your book and the mood you want.
- Storyboard: We outline scenes and script.
- Produce: We edit the first cut.
- Finish: We apply feedback and export.

Benefits:
- A shareable asset for every channel
- Clear licensing for stock and music
- Visuals consistent with your cover
- Versions sized for each platform

Questions:
Q: How long is a trailer?
A: Usually 30 to 90 seconds, which suits social platforms and retailer pages.

Q: Do you use actors?
A: Our trailers are built from licensed footage, animation and graphics.

Q: Can I choose the music?
A: Yes, from licensed options we present or tracks you have licensed.

Q: Where can I use the trailer?
A: On your website, social channels and video platforms. Some retailers also accept video.

## Book Illustrations
URL: https://amazonselfpublishers.co/book-illustrations-designing-services

**Illustrations that carry your story from page to page**

Whether it is a picture book, a fantasy map or a set of diagrams, we match you with illustrators who can create consistent, print-ready artwork in the style your book needs.

Illustration is storytelling. Characters must look the same on page two and page twenty, colours must hold together and every picture must sit comfortably next to the text.

We start with style exploration and character sketches, then move through layouts, final art and file preparation.

Who it is for:
- Children's book authors
- Fantasy and sci-fi writers needing maps
- Non-fiction authors with diagrams
- Authors of cookbooks and activity books

What is included:
- Style exploration: Sample directions so you choose a look before full art begins.
- Character design: Consistent character sheets for recurring figures.
- Page and spot illustrations: Full-page, half-page or small decorative pieces.
- Cover art integration: Art prepared to work with the cover design.
- Print-ready files: High-resolution files with correct colour mode.
- Revision stages: Feedback at sketch and colour stages.

Process:
- Brief: Share the story, age group and references.
- Sketch: Thumbnails and character concepts.
- Colour: Final colouring and detail.
- Deliver: Files prepared for layout and print.

Benefits:
- Consistent characters and style
- Art sized for your trim and printer
- Illustrators matched to genre
- Feedback at each stage

Questions:
Q: Who owns the illustrations?
A: Usage rights are set out in your agreement. We aim to give authors the rights needed to publish and sell their book.

Q: How many illustrations does a picture book need?
A: Many picture books run 24 to 32 pages. We advise on the number that fits your story.

Q: Can I provide my own sketches?
A: Yes, rough sketches help us understand what you want.

Q: Can you illustrate adult books?
A: Yes, including maps, diagrams, chapter art and graphic elements.

## Book Cover Design
URL: https://amazonselfpublishers.co/book-cover-designing-services

**A cover that looks right in a thumbnail and in the hand**

Readers do judge a book by its cover. We design covers that fit your genre, read clearly at thumbnail size and are built to the right specifications for print and digital.

A cover must work at two scales: tiny on a retail page and large on a shelf. The title has to be legible, the imagery must signal genre and the finished design must feel distinctive without feeling out of place.

We study your genre, discuss what your book is about and present concepts that balance both needs.

Who it is for:
- Authors publishing for the first time
- Authors refreshing an older cover
- Series authors who need a consistent look
- Non-fiction authors needing authority

What is included:
- Concept options: Distinct directions to choose between.
- Front cover design: Typography and imagery tailored to the genre.
- Full wrap for print: Front, spine and back with barcode space.
- Ebook cover: Digital cover sized for stores.
- Promotional versions: Flat covers and previews for social and website use.
- Revision rounds: Adjustments to hit the right look.

Process:
- Questionnaire: Genre, comparables and preferences.
- Concepts: We present initial designs.
- Refine: We develop the chosen direction.
- Final files: Print and ebook files delivered.

Benefits:
- Genre-appropriate design
- Correct spine and bleed for print
- Legible at thumbnail size
- Matching assets for marketing

Questions:
Q: Do I need to know the page count?
A: For a print wrap, yes. The spine width depends on page count and paper type. We can estimate and adjust later.

Q: Can you use my own artwork?
A: Yes, provided you have the rights to it.

Q: How many revisions are included?
A: Revision rounds are set out in your quote. Extra rounds can be added if needed.

Q: Are stock images licensed?
A: We use properly licensed imagery and share licence details when needed.

## Book Printing
URL: https://amazonselfpublishers.co/book-printing-services

**Printed books that feel as good as they look on screen**

Paper stock, binding, trim size and print method affect cost and quality. We help you choose, prepare the files and review a proof before the run.

You can print a book on demand, one copy at a time, or order a short run for events and direct sales. Each route has its own costs, lead times and file requirements.

We explain the options, prepare the files and help you compare quotes so you choose with confidence.

Who it is for:
- Authors planning paperback or hardcover editions
- Authors ordering copies for launch events
- Businesses printing branded books
- Authors comparing print-on-demand and offset

What is included:
- Specification advice: Trim size, paper, cover finish and binding for your genre.
- Print-ready PDFs: Interior and cover files with bleed and correct colour mode.
- Printer quotes: Guidance on obtaining and comparing quotes.
- Proof review: Check a proof copy before approving a run.
- Barcode and ISBN placement: Assistance with positioning and format.
- Order coordination: Support through ordering and delivery.

Process:
- Choose specs: Decide on size, paper and binding.
- Prepare: Finalise print files.
- Proof: Order and review a proof.
- Print: Approve and place your order.

Benefits:
- Fewer surprises on delivery
- Specifications chosen for your genre
- Clear comparison of print routes
- Files ready for the printer

Questions:
Q: What is print on demand?
A: Books are printed individually when ordered, so no inventory is required.

Q: When does offset printing make sense?
A: Larger runs, special finishes and lower unit costs at volume.

Q: Do I need an ISBN?
A: Many retail channels require one. We explain your options.

Q: Can you print hardcovers?
A: Yes, through printers that offer case-bound and dust-jacket formats.

## Copywriting
URL: https://amazonselfpublishers.co/copy-writing-services

**Words that persuade without overselling**

Your book blurb, author bio and sales page are often the last thing a reader sees before deciding. We write copy that is clear, specific and true to your book.

Copywriting is condensed storytelling. It has to catch attention quickly, convey value and give the reader a reason to act, all in a few lines.

We learn what makes your book distinctive, identify your reader's motivation and write copy that connects the two.

Who it is for:
- Authors writing a book description
- Authors launching a website
- Businesses promoting a book
- Anyone needing an author bio

What is included:
- Book descriptions: Retailer-ready blurbs with a hook and a clear promise.
- Author bios: Short and long versions for different uses.
- Sales and landing pages: Page copy with structure and calls to action.
- Email sequences: Launch and nurture emails for your list.
- Ad copy: Headlines and text for social and search campaigns.
- Tone guide: A short summary of your brand voice.

Process:
- Discovery: Understand book, audience and goals.
- Draft: Write options.
- Review: Refine with your feedback.
- Finalise: Deliver ready-to-use copy.

Benefits:
- Clear messaging
- Honest persuasion
- Consistent voice across channels
- Time saved

Questions:
Q: What is the difference between copywriting and content writing?
A: Copywriting aims to prompt an action, such as buying or signing up. Content writing informs and builds trust over time.

Q: Can you write in my voice?
A: Yes. Samples help us match tone.

Q: How many versions will I receive?
A: We usually provide a primary version and alternatives for headlines.

Q: Do you A/B test copy?
A: We can suggest tests; running them requires your platform and traffic.

## Ghostwriting
URL: https://amazonselfpublishers.co/ghost-writing-services

**Your story and expertise, written by a professional, published under your name**

Ghostwriting lets you hold the byline while an experienced writer does the drafting. You supply ideas and approval; we supply structure, research and prose.

Many authors have a story or expertise worth sharing but not the time or confidence to draft a full manuscript. A ghostwriter interviews, outlines and writes in your voice.

We keep your project confidential and agree ownership terms in writing before work begins.

Who it is for:
- Memoirists and family historians
- Executives writing a business book
- Experts turning knowledge into a guide
- Fiction authors with detailed outlines

What is included:
- Discovery interviews: Recorded or written conversations to capture your story and voice.
- Detailed outline: A chapter plan for your approval.
- Chapter drafts: Delivered in stages for feedback.
- Voice matching: Prose that sounds like you.
- Revision rounds: Changes based on your notes.
- Final manuscript: A complete, consistent draft ready for editing.

Process:
- Match: Pair you with a suitable writer.
- Outline: Agree structure and tone.
- Draft: Receive chapters and give feedback.
- Complete: Finalise the manuscript.

Benefits:
- Confidentiality
- Full ownership terms agreed upfront
- Writers matched to your genre
- A steady schedule with milestones

Questions:
Q: Is ghostwriting ethical?
A: Yes. It is a long-established practice, and the author remains the originator of the ideas and the owner of the book.

Q: Will my ghostwriter be credited?
A: Only if you wish. Confidentiality is standard.

Q: How long does a book take?
A: It depends on length and how quickly feedback is returned. We give a timeline in your proposal.

Q: Who owns the manuscript?
A: You do, as set out in your agreement.

## Book Editing & Proofreading
URL: https://amazonselfpublishers.co/book-editing-proofreading-services

**Editing at the right level, and proofreading at the right moment**

Editing and proofreading are different jobs done at different times. We explain which your manuscript needs and deliver both with care.

Developmental editing looks at structure, pacing and argument. Copyediting fixes grammar, consistency and style. Proofreading is the final check for typos after layout.

Doing them in the wrong order wastes money. We recommend the sequence that fits your draft and track changes so you stay in control.

Who it is for:
- Authors with a first draft
- Authors whose manuscripts are nearly done
- Writers about to publish
- Non-fiction authors needing clarity

What is included:
- Manuscript assessment: An overview of strengths and issues.
- Developmental edit: Structural feedback and revision guidance.
- Copyedit: Grammar, style and consistency.
- Proofread: Final read of laid-out pages.
- Style sheet: A record of spellings and conventions.
- Tracked changes: Every edit visible for review.

Process:
- Assess: Decide the level of editing.
- Edit: Edit with tracked changes.
- Review: Accept or reject edits.
- Proof: Final proofread after layout.

Benefits:
- Fix problems early
- Control through tracked changes
- Fresh eyes on your work
- Consistent style

Questions:
Q: What is the difference between editing and proofreading?
A: Editing improves the writing itself. Proofreading checks a near-final version for remaining errors.

Q: Do I need both?
A: Most books benefit from both, at different stages.

Q: Can I see a sample edit?
A: Yes. A sample on a short excerpt helps you judge fit.

Q: Will you change my voice?
A: No. Editors improve clarity while preserving style.

## Blog Writing
URL: https://amazonselfpublishers.co/blog-writing

**A steady stream of blog posts your readers will actually read**

A blog keeps your site fresh and gives readers reasons to return. We plan topics, write original posts and keep a regular rhythm so you do not have to.

Blogging works when it is consistent and useful. Many authors start enthusiastically and stop after a few posts because the effort adds up.

We take over the writing, with your approval, so your blog stays active and aligned with your goals.

Who it is for:
- Authors building a platform
- Businesses supporting a book launch
- Experts building authority
- Sites needing regular content

What is included:
- Editorial calendar: A schedule of topics.
- Original posts: Researched articles in your voice.
- SEO structure: Headings, meta descriptions and internal links.
- Image suggestions: Guidance on featured images.
- Review cycle: Approval before publishing.
- Upload on request: Posting to your site if you want.

Process:
- Plan: Choose topics and cadence.
- Write: Draft posts.
- Approve: Review and edit.
- Publish: Post and promote.

Benefits:
- Consistent publishing
- Original content
- Topics aligned with your goals
- Less time pressure

Questions:
Q: How often should I post?
A: Quality matters more than frequency. Weekly or fortnightly works for many authors.

Q: Do you handle images?
A: We suggest images; licensing is your responsibility unless we agree otherwise.

Q: Can you write about my book?
A: Yes, using your notes or the manuscript.

Q: Is this the same as article writing?
A: Similar, but blog writing is planned as an ongoing series with a calendar.

## Book Promotion
URL: https://amazonselfpublishers.co/book-promotion

**Get your book in front of readers who will care about it**

Promotion is the active side of marketing. We run outreach, features and campaigns that bring your book to the attention of the right readers.

Promotion has to match the book. A cosy mystery calls for different channels than a business handbook. We pick places where your readers already spend time.

We handle the groundwork, which is often the slow part, and report back plainly on what happened.

Who it is for:
- Authors in launch week
- Authors with an older title
- Authors running a limited-time offer
- Authors needing reviews

What is included:
- Promotion plan: Channels and timing.
- Reader outreach: Pitches to bloggers, reviewers and newsletters.
- Social campaigns: Posts and graphics.
- Review requests: Ethical approaches to early reviews.
- Promotional assets: Graphics, quotes and press materials.
- Campaign report: Summary of activity and results.

Process:
- Plan: Set goals and audience.
- Prepare: Create assets.
- Promote: Run outreach and campaigns.
- Report: Review outcomes.

Benefits:
- Targeted reach
- Ethical review practices
- Ready-made promotional materials
- Clear reporting

Questions:
Q: Do you buy reviews?
A: No. Paid or fake reviews break platform rules. We only pursue genuine reader feedback.

Q: What results can I expect?
A: We cannot promise specific sales or rankings. We report what we did and what happened.

Q: How long does a campaign run?
A: Typically several weeks around a launch, with options to continue.

Q: Is promotion different from marketing?
A: Marketing is the overall strategy, and promotion is the activity that carries it out.
